questions.explanation: 根据上下文，作者原以为它和其他冠军狗一样，但立刻“认出/察觉”(recognized)了它的独特之处。A(changed)改变；B(rejected)拒绝；C(improved)改善，均不合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(changed)：语境句：He has changed a lot since we last met. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change into
B(rejected)：语境句：The committee rejected his proposal due to a lack of funds. 固定搭配：reject an offer, firmly reject
C(improved)：语境句：Her spoken English has improved significantly over the past year. 固定搭配：improve dramatically, room for improvement
D(recognized)：语境句：I recognized my old friend immediately in the crowd. 固定搭配：recognize the importance of, be widely recognized

questions.explanation: 狗歪着头，棕色的眼睛“追踪/观察”(tracking)孩子们微小的面部表情。B(terrifying)使恐惧；C(causing)引起；D(avoiding)避免，与治疗犬温和的天性不符。
questions.supplement:
A(tracking)：语境句：The scientists are tracking the movement of the endangered birds. 固定搭配：keep track of, track down
B(terrifying)：语境句：The loud thunder was a terrifying experience for the little girl. 固定搭配：terrifying experience, terrifying thought
C(causing)：语境句：The heavy rain is causing massive traffic jams in the city. 固定搭配：cause trouble, cause damage
D(avoiding)：语境句：He is deliberately avoiding answering my questions. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, try to avoid

questions.explanation: 因为这只狗善于观察人类的细微表情，说明它具有“富有洞察力的”(insightful)天性，因此作者决定把它训练成治疗犬。A(graceful)优雅的；C(amusing)有趣的；D(dominant)占优势的，均不符合逻辑连贯性。
questions.supplement:
A(graceful)：语境句：The dancers performed with graceful movements on the stage. 固定搭配：graceful movements, graceful manner
B(insightful)：语境句：The professor provided an insightful analysis of the economic crisis. 固定搭配：insightful comments, insightful observation
C(amusing)：语境句：He told us an amusing story that made everyone laugh. 固定搭配：amusing anecdote, highly amusing
D(dominant)：语境句：The company has maintained a dominant position in the global market. 固定搭配：dominant role, dominant position

questions.explanation: 它的工作是去“访问”(visit)小学班级听学生读书。下文提到的“Over 200 school visits”也直接提示了该选项。B(design)设计；C(interrupt)打断；D(instruct)指导，均不符合狗作为陪伴者的身份。
questions.supplement:
A(visit)：语境句：We plan to visit several historical museums during the trip. 固定搭配：pay a visit to, return a visit
B(design)：语境句：The architect was hired to design a new library for the university. 固定搭配：custom design, design specifically for
C(interrupt)：语境句：Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking. 固定搭配：interrupt a conversation, be frequently interrupted
D(instruct)：语境句：The teacher instructed the students to complete the assignment in silence. 固定搭配：instruct sb to do sth, strictly instruct

questions.explanation: undivided attention 是固定搭配，意为“全神贯注”。这只狗对读书的孩子全神贯注地倾听，从不打断。A(unwanted)不需要的；B(uncomfortable)不舒服的；D(unusual)不寻常的。
questions.supplement:
A(unwanted)：语境句：He threw away all the unwanted items in his room. 固定搭配：unwanted attention, unwanted pregnancy
B(uncomfortable)：语境句：These tight shoes are making me feel uncomfortable. 固定搭配：feel uncomfortable, an uncomfortable silence
C(undivided)：语境句：Please give me your undivided attention while I explain the rules. 固定搭配：undivided attention, undivided loyalty
D(unusual)：语境句：It is unusual for him to be late for such an important meeting. 固定搭配：highly unusual, quite unusual

questions.explanation: 读完书后，孩子们可以把一块“零食/狗粮”(treat)放在它鼻子上，狗会将其抛起接住，这是常见的奖励狗的行为。A(page)页码；C(coin)硬币；D(hand)手，均不符合逗狗的常理。
questions.supplement:
A(page)：语境句：Please turn to the next page of the textbook. 固定搭配：front page, blank page
B(treat)：语境句：She gave her dog a treat for learning a new trick. 固定搭配：dog treat, as a special treat
C(coin)：语境句：He flipped a coin to decide who would go first. 固定搭配：flip a coin, coin collecting
D(hand)：语境句：Could you give me a hand with these heavy boxes? 固定搭配：give sb a hand, hand in hand

questions.explanation: 一天，一个特教学生“加入”(joined)了我们的课堂。A(witnessed)目击；B(led)带领；D(invited)邀请，均与语境“学生来到班级一起活动”不符。
questions.supplement:
A(witnessed)：语境句：Several bystanders witnessed the traffic accident yesterday. 固定搭配：witness a crime, bear witness to
B(led)：语境句：The local guide led the tourists through the dense forest. 固定搭配：lead to, lead the way
C(joined)：语境句：Would you like to join us for dinner tonight? 固定搭配：join in, join hands with
D(invited)：语境句：They invited all their relatives to the wedding ceremony. 固定搭配：invite sb over, invite sb to do sth

questions.explanation: 结合男孩发抖的膝盖(shaking knees)以及后面话语卡在喉咙里的描述，说明这个特教男孩十分“费力地”(with great effort)在尝试读书。B(respect)尊重；C(risk)风险；D(speed)速度，都不符合努力克服阅读障碍的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(effort)：语境句：She passed the difficult exam with great effort. 固定搭配：make an effort, spare no effort
B(respect)：语境句：We should show respect for people from different cultural backgrounds. 固定搭配：show respect for, earn respect
C(risk)：语境句：Investing in the stock market always involves a certain degree of risk. 固定搭配：take a risk, at the risk of
D(speed)：语境句：The car was traveling at a high speed when it crashed. 固定搭配：at top speed, speed up

questions.explanation: 男孩因为结巴读不出单词，话“卡在”(got stuck)喉咙里。A(turned up)出现；C(spread out)散开；D(came true)实现。
questions.supplement:
A(turned up)：语境句：We waited for an hour, but he never turned up. 固定搭配：turn up the volume, turn up late
B(got stuck)：语境句：My car got stuck in the mud and couldn't move. 固定搭配：get stuck in traffic, get stuck in a rut
C(spread out)：语境句：The search party spread out to cover more ground. 固定搭配：spread out the map, widely spread
D(came true)：语境句：After years of hard work, his dream of becoming an actor finally came true. 固定搭配：come true, a dream come true

questions.explanation: 狗主动帮助男孩，用冰凉的“鼻子”(nose)推了推印有帽子的那一页。狗的鼻子特征为cool，且下文提到Henry smelt the book(狗闻书)，均暗示是狗的鼻子。A(wind)风；B(teacher)老师；C(finger)手指。
questions.supplement:
A(wind)：语境句：The strong wind blew away the autumn leaves. 固定搭配：strong wind, catch one's wind
B(teacher)：语境句：She is a dedicated teacher who inspires her students. 固定搭配：head teacher, strict teacher
C(finger)：语境句：He pointed a finger at the map to show the location. 固定搭配：point a finger at, cross one's fingers
D(nose)：语境句：The dog used its nose to sniff out the hidden food. 固定搭配：under one's nose, a running nose

questions.explanation: 老师说了一句“太棒了！”，作者以为她指的是狗很棒，所以回答说它确实是只好狗。mean在此处意为“指代、意思是”。A(encouraged)鼓励；B(ordered)命令；C(compared)比较。
questions.supplement:
A(encouraged)：语境句：My parents always encouraged me to pursue my dreams. 固定搭配：encourage sb to do sth, actively encourage
B(ordered)：语境句：The officer ordered the soldiers to stand in line. 固定搭配：order sb to do sth, in order
C(compared)：语境句：The teacher compared his writing style to that of Shakespeare. 固定搭配：compare A with/to B, compared to/with
D(meant)：语境句：I didn't quite catch what he meant by that comment. 固定搭配：be meant to be, mean doing sth

questions.explanation: 老师澄清说，这不是指狗，而是指这名特教学生第一次读得这么“流畅”(smoothly)。与前文男孩极度费力、结巴的表现形成鲜明对比。B(regularly)定期地；C(carefully)仔细地；D(silently)默默地。
questions.supplement:
A(smoothly)：语境句：Thanks to everyone's cooperation, the project went very smoothly. 固定搭配：go smoothly, run smoothly
B(regularly)：语境句：You need to exercise regularly to stay in good health. 固定搭配：check regularly, happen regularly
C(carefully)：语境句：He examined the rare painting carefully to verify its authenticity. 固定搭配：listen carefully, consider carefully
D(silently)：语境句：The cat crept silently across the room towards the mouse. 固定搭配：suffer silently, wait silently

questions.explanation: 让一个结巴、恐惧的特教孩子能够流利阅读并大声喊出单词，这是狗创造的微小的“奇迹”(miracles)。A(memories)记忆；C(sounds)声音；D(opportunities)机会。
questions.supplement:
A(memories)：语境句：The old photographs brought back many fond memories of my childhood. 固定搭配：fond memories, refresh one's memory
B(miracles)：语境句：It's a miracle that nobody was hurt in the terrible accident. 固定搭配：work miracles, perform a miracle
C(sounds)：语境句：The sounds of the city traffic kept him awake all night. 固定搭配：make a sound, sound familiar
D(opportunities)：语境句：The internet has created many new opportunities for small businesses. 固定搭配：seize an opportunity, miss an opportunity

questions.explanation: transform A into B 意为“把A转变为B”，狗把孩子们无声的恐惧“转变”成了勇敢的声音。A(persuaded)说服；B(broke)打破；C(brought)带来，均无法与into直接连用表示转化。
questions.supplement:
A(persuaded)：语境句：She persuaded her husband to quit smoking for the sake of his health. 固定搭配：persuade sb to do sth, persuade sb of sth
B(broke)：语境句：He accidentally broke the fragile vase into pieces. 固定搭配：break down, break into
C(brought)：语境句：The new policy has brought significant benefits to the local community. 固定搭配：bring about, bring up
D(transformed)：语境句：The caterpillar eventually transformed into a beautiful butterfly. 固定搭配：transform A into B, completely transform

questions.explanation: 随着时间流逝，孩子们逐渐长大“不再需要”(outgrew)图画书了，教室也换了海报，但那只红毛的倾听者却始终如一。outgrow 意为因长大而不再适用于/不需要某物。A(overlooked)忽略；B(downloaded)下载；D(undertook)承担。
questions.supplement:
A(overlooked)：语境句：His hard work was entirely overlooked by the management. 固定搭配：overlook a mistake, easily overlooked
B(downloaded)：语境句：I downloaded a new app to help me manage my schedule. 固定搭配：download from, illegally download
C(outgrew)：语境句：My son quickly outgrew the clothes we bought him last year. 固定搭配：outgrow one's clothes, outgrow a habit
D(undertook)：语境句：He undertook the responsibility of organizing the annual charity event. 固定搭配：undertake a task, undertake to do sth

vocab_pack.definition_en: a dog that is trained and exhibited in dog shows
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中用作 a show dog，为名词短语，作介词 to be 的表语，表示‘被训练成赛级犬’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The breeder sold the puppy to a family who wanted a show dog.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 饲养员把这只小狗卖给了一个想要赛级犬的家庭。
vocab_pack.from_passage: My Irish setter, Henry, had been trained to be a show dog.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to behave proudly and confidently
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 昂首挺胸；表现出骄傲和自信
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中为现在分词短语 holding their heads high，作伴随状语，描述其他赛犬的行为。动词 hold 的现在分词形式与逻辑主语 other champion dogs 保持一致。
vocab_pack.example_en: Despite the failure, she held her head high and walked off the stage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管失败了，她仍然昂首挺胸地走下舞台。
vocab_pack.from_passage: while other champion dogs enjoyed holding their heads high in the spotlight

vocab_pack.definition_en: receiving a lot of public attention
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 处于聚光灯下；备受关注
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中为介词短语，作状语修饰 holding their heads high，表示‘在聚光灯下’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The young actor was suddenly in the spotlight after winning the award.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位年轻演员在获奖后突然成为了公众关注的焦点。
vocab_pack.from_passage: while other champion dogs enjoyed holding their heads high in the spotlight

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remain in the company of (someone); to not leave
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 would stay with 为过去将来时，would 表示过去习惯性动作，stay 为动词原形，with 为介词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The little girl asked her mother to stay with her during the thunderstorm.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 小女孩请求妈妈在雷雨时陪在她身边。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Henry would stay with children off stage.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move something so that it is not straight or level; to tip
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 tilted 为一般过去时，谓语动词，表示亨利倾斜头部。
vocab_pack.example_en: He tilted his head to listen more carefully to the faint sound.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他歪着头，以便更仔细地听那微弱的声音。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He tilted his head, brown eyes tracking their minor facial expressions.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow the movements or path of (someone or something)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 追踪；跟随（某人的运动或路径）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 tracking 为现在分词，作伴随状语，与 tilted 并列，表示‘追踪着他们的细微面部表情’。动名词形式表示主动且进行。
vocab_pack.example_en: The detective tracked the suspect through the crowded streets.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 侦探穿过拥挤的街道追踪嫌疑人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He tilted his head, brown eyes tracking their minor facial expressions.

vocab_pack.definition_en: having or showing a deep understanding of a person or situation
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 有洞察力的；富有见地的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 insightful 为形容词，修饰 nature，作定语。与 welcoming 并列，构成‘insightful nature and welcoming presence’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her insightful comments helped us solve the problem quickly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她富有见地的评论帮助我们迅速解决了问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Because of his insightful nature and welcoming presence, I decided to retrain him to be a therapy dog.

vocab_pack.definition_en: friendly and making someone feel welcome
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 欢迎的；热情的；令人感到温暖的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 welcoming 为形容词，修饰 presence，作定语。与 insightful 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hotel staff gave us a very welcoming smile.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 酒店员工向我们报以非常热情的微笑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Because of his insightful nature and welcoming presence, I decided to retrain him to be a therapy dog.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a dog trained to provide comfort, affection, and support to people in hospitals, schools, etc.
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 治疗犬（经过训练，为医院、学校等场所的人提供安慰和支持的狗）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 therapy dog 为名词短语，作不定式 to be 的表语，表示‘治疗犬’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hospital introduced a therapy dog to help reduce patients' anxiety.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医院引入了一只治疗犬，帮助减轻患者的焦虑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I decided to retrain him to be a therapy dog.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to concentrate completely on someone or something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 全神贯注；给予全部的注意力
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 gave undivided attention 为一般过去时，谓语动词 give 的过去式，undivided 为形容词修饰 attention，表示‘给予阅读者全部的关注’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher gave undivided attention to each student's question.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师对每个学生的问题都给予了全部的注意力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He gave undivided attention to the readers and never corrected or laughed at them when they stuttered.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make fun of someone or something in a mocking way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 laughed at 为一般过去时，谓语动词 laugh 的过去式，at 为介词，表示‘嘲笑他们’。与 never corrected 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's not polite to laugh at people when they make mistakes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当别人犯错时嘲笑他们是不礼貌的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He gave undivided attention to the readers and never corrected or laughed at them when they stuttered.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to speak with difficulty, repeating sounds or words or pausing involuntarily
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 stuttered 为一般过去时，when 引导的时间状语从句中的谓语动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: He stuttered when he was nervous, but he still managed to give the speech.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他紧张时会口吃，但还是完成了演讲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He gave undivided attention to the readers and never corrected or laughed at them when they stuttered.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a small food item given as a reward
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 零食；奖励品（尤指给宠物的）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 treat 为名词，作宾语，与 put a treat on Henry's nose 搭配，表示‘把零食放在亨利的鼻子上’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dog gets a treat every time it follows a command.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这只狗每次遵守命令都会得到一块零食。
vocab_pack.from_passage: After reading, students got to put a treat on Henry's nose, which he'd flip up and catch in his mouth.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause something to turn over or move quickly upward
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 he'd flip up 为 would flip up 的缩写，过去将来时，flip 为动词原形，up 为副词，表示‘向上翻动（零食）’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magician flipped up the coin and caught it effortlessly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 魔术师把硬币向上抛起，然后轻松接住。
vocab_pack.from_passage: After reading, students got to put a treat on Henry's nose, which he'd flip up and catch in his mouth.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to intercept and hold something using the mouth
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 catch in his mouth 为动词原形，与 flip up 并列，接在 would 后。in his mouth 为介词短语作状语，表示‘用嘴接住’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dog can catch a ball in its mouth even from a distance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这只狗即使从很远的地方也能用嘴接住球。
vocab_pack.from_passage: After reading, students got to put a treat on Henry's nose, which he'd flip up and catch in his mouth.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be in a horizontal position on a surface
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 lay 是动词 lie 的过去式，表示‘躺在地上’。注意 lie 的过去式为 lay，过去分词为 lain。此处为一般过去时，谓语动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a long walk, the dog likes to lie on the cool floor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 长途散步后，狗狗喜欢躺在凉爽的地板上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Henry lay on the floor against the boy's shaking knees as he worked with great effort to read his picture book.

vocab_pack.definition_en: using a lot of physical or mental energy; with difficulty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 with great effort 为介词短语作状语，修饰 worked，表示‘非常努力地读图画书’。
vocab_pack.example_en: He climbed the steep mountain with great effort.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他费力地爬上了陡峭的山。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Henry lay on the floor against the boy's shaking knees as he worked with great effort to read his picture book.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become fixed or unable to move forward; to be unable to continue
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 被卡住；陷入困境；讲不出来
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 got stuck 为一般过去时的被动结构或系表结构，get 为系动词，stuck 为过去分词，表示‘词语卡在喉咙里（说不出来）’。
vocab_pack.example_en: I often get stuck on difficult math problems.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我经常在难题上卡住。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Words got stuck in his throat.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to perceive the odor of something by using the nose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 smelt 为动词 smell 的过去式（英式拼写），一般过去时，谓语动词。注意 smell 的过去式也可用 smelled。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dog can smell food from a long distance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 狗能从很远的地方闻到食物的味道。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Henry smelt the book, and the boy read three words.

vocab_pack.definition_en: immediately after; at the moment that
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 As soon as 为连词，引导时间状语从句，从句用一般过去时 finished，主句用过去时 whispered，表示‘他们一读完，老师就低声说’。
vocab_pack.example_en: As soon as the bell rang, the students rushed out of the classroom.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 铃声一响，学生们就冲出了教室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As soon as they finished, the teacher whispered, "That was amazing!"

vocab_pack.definition_en: to read without pauses or errors; fluently
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 has ever read smoothly 为现在完成时，smoothly 为副词修饰 read，表示‘曾经流利地阅读过’。this student has ever read smoothly 是定语从句修饰 the first time。
vocab_pack.example_en: After months of practice, she can now read smoothly in English.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过几个月的练习，她现在能流利地阅读英语了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: that is the first time this student has ever read smoothly !

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something to someone in recognition of their efforts or achievements
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 was rewarded 为一般过去时的被动语态，rewarded 为过去分词，表示‘被奖励了600多块饼干’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company rewards employees who perform well with bonuses.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司用奖金奖励表现优异的员工。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Over 200 school visits, Henry was rewarded more than 600 biscuits and transformed silent fears into brave voices.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to change something completely into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 transformed silent fears into brave voices 为一般过去时，transformed 为动词过去式，into 引出转变的结果，表示‘将沉默的恐惧转变为勇敢的声音’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The old factory was transformed into a modern art museum.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座旧工厂被改造成了一座现代艺术博物馆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Over 200 school visits, Henry was rewarded more than 600 biscuits and transformed silent fears into brave voices.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to grow too big for something (e.g., clothes, a habit, or an interest)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 长得太大而不再适用；随着年龄增长而摆脱（习惯、兴趣等）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 outgrew 为一般过去时，谓语动词，表示‘孩子们长大了，不再看图画书了’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Children often outgrow their fear of the dark as they get older.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们随着年龄增长通常会不再害怕黑暗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Children outgrew picture books, and classrooms changed posters, but my red-furred listener remained constant.

vocab_pack.definition_en: having red hair or fur
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 red-furred 为复合形容词，由 red（红色）+ fur（皮毛）+ -ed（形容词后缀）构成，修饰 listener，表示‘红毛的听众’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The red-furred fox ran swiftly through the forest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只红毛狐狸迅速跑过了森林。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Children outgrew picture books, and classrooms changed posters, but my red-furred listener remained constant.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stay the same; not to change
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 remained constant 为系表结构，remained 为系动词过去式，constant 为形容词作表语，表示‘始终不变’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Throughout the experiment, the temperature remained constant.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在整个实验过程中，温度保持不变。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Children outgrew picture books, and classrooms changed posters, but my red-furred listener remained constant.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used before a noun to emphasize that something is unusual, impressive, or of a particular quality
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 相当……的；不寻常的（用于名词前加强语气）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 quite a dog 为短语，quite a 修饰 dog，表示‘相当棒的一只狗’。口语中常用。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is quite a talented musician.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他是个相当有天赋的音乐家。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Yes, he's quite a dog."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to pay attention to someone or something that you can hear
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 listen to 为动词原形，与 visit 并列，接在 to 后（His job was to visit... and listen to）。listen to 后接宾语 students reading。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should listen to your teacher's advice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该听从老师的建议。
vocab_pack.from_passage: His job was to visit elementary school classes and listen to students reading to him.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become a member of a group or to take part in an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 joined 为一般过去时，谓语动词，表示‘一个特殊教育学生加入了我们班’。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to join the school choir after the audition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 试音后她决定加入学校合唱团。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One day, a special education student joined us in class.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something right or accurate; to point out errors
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 中文：文中 corrected 为一般过去时，谓语动词，与 laughed at 并列，表示‘从未纠正或嘲笑他们’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher corrected the mistakes in my essay.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师纠正了我作文中的错误。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He gave undivided attention to the readers and never corrected or laughed at them when they stuttered.

section_2_word_form.passage:
The winter holiday season shines with decorations and lights. It is this time of year when Harbin, known as the city of ice, becomes a winter wonderland [56] in silver and white.
In Harbin, [57] catches our eyes and leaves us stunned is its ice sculptures, which are more than frozen art, but a symbol of human wisdom, proving that even in the extreme cold, beauty can thrive.
On the frozen Songhua River, the only source of crystal-clear and bubble-free ice, workers are busy harvesting thousands of cubic meters of ice [58] the splendid Harbin Ice and Snow World. They slice the surface into blocks of the same size, each [59] 700 kg. At the construction site, to support massive structures like twin ice towers, engineers first build steel frames up to 40 meters tall, around which ice blocks [60] like bricks. Then they fill the gaps [61] frames and blocks with ice and water, which freeze [62] to rock-solid walls. For unique structures, workers apply water mixed with paper pulp(纸浆) onto a blown-up mould(模具), creating ice three times stronger than normal. Days later, the mould is removed, revealing [63] amazing, durable creation. LED lights are embedded in carved sinks, layer by layer, changing sculptures into glowing wonders.
Despite immense [64] — slippery surfaces, -25℃ and time limits, the teams work 24/7 in shifts. Their dedication turns raw ice into breathtaking art — the art [65] is momentary, but the experience and the delicate beauty will last forever.

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，此处作后置定语修饰wonderland，wonderland与wrap之间是被动关系（被包裹在银装素裹中），故填过去分词wrapped。
questions.supplement: 正确形(wrapped)：语境句：The present was beautifully wrapped in gold paper. 固定搭配：be wrapped in, wrap up。原词wrap其它变形：wrapping(n.), wrapper(n.)

questions.explanation: 此处引导主语从句，并在从句“__ catches our eyes...”中充当主语，指代引起注意的事物，故用代词What。句首注意首字母大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(What)：语境句：What we need most right now is more time. 固定搭配：what about, no matter what。原词what其它变形：whatever(pron./adj.), somewhat(adv.)

questions.explanation: 工人们忙着采集数以千计立方米的冰块，其目的是为了“建造”冰雪大世界。表示目的应用动词不定式。
knowledge_points: 动词不定式作目的状语
questions.supplement: 正确形(to build)：语境句：They are raising funds to build a new hospital in the village. 固定搭配：build up, build on。原词build其它变形：building(n.), builder(n.), rebuilt(v.)

questions.explanation: 此处为独立主格结构“逻辑主语 each + 分词”。each与weigh之间是主动关系（每块重达700公斤），故填现在分词weighing。
questions.supplement: 正确形(weighing)：语境句：He caught a huge fish weighing over twenty pounds. 固定搭配：weigh in, weigh one's words。原词weigh其它变形：weight(n.), weighty(adj.), weightless(adj.)

questions.explanation: 这是一个以which引导的定语从句，先行词为steel frames。从句的主语是ice blocks（复数），动词pile（堆放）与冰块之间为被动关系。文章时态为一般现在时，故填are piled。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are piled)：语境句：Books are piled high on his desk. 固定搭配：pile up, a pile of。原词pile其它变形：piled(adj.), piling(n.)

questions.explanation: 句意为：然后他们用冰和水填补钢架和冰块“之间”的空隙。常见固定搭配 between A and B 意为在A和B两者之间。
questions.supplement: 正确形(between)：语境句：There is a clear distinction between the two concepts. 固定搭配：between A and B, in between。原词between其它变形：无特殊变形

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词freeze，意为“瞬间冻结”，需要用副词形式，故将形容词instant变为副词instantly。
questions.supplement: 正确形(instantly)：语境句：The driver was killed instantly in the violent crash. 固定搭配：react instantly, recognize instantly。原词instant其它变形：instant(adj./n.), instance(n.)

questions.explanation: creation在此处指代“一件作品”，为可数名词单数。其前面的修饰语amazing以元音音素开头，故需填入不定冠词an表示泛指“一个”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(an)：语境句：It was an absolute honor to meet the famous author. 固定搭配：an hour, an apple。原词an无特殊变形，为冠词(a/an)

questions.explanation: challenge作“挑战”解为可数名词。根据破折号后列举的内容（湿滑的表面、-25℃的低温、时间限制）可知，工人们面临着多重挑战，故使用复数形式challenges。
questions.supplement: 正确形(challenges)：语境句：We must be prepared to face any challenges ahead. 固定搭配：face a challenge, overcome challenges。原词challenge其它变形：challenging(adj.), challenged(adj.)

questions.explanation: 句意：艺术“本身”是短暂的，但体验和美感将永存。此处填反身代词itself作主语the art的同位语，起强调作用。
questions.supplement: 正确形(itself)：语境句：The town itself is very small, but its surroundings are beautiful. 固定搭配：by itself, in itself。原词it其它变形：its(pron.), itself(pron.)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to surround or cover something with something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 wrapped in 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 winter wonderland，表示被动状态“被银白色包裹着”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city was wrapped in a thick fog in the morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市早晨被浓雾笼罩。
vocab_pack.from_passage: wrapped in silver and white

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract someone's attention
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 catches our eyes 为一般现在时第三人称单数形式（what作主语），宾语为复数 our eyes，但固定搭配通常用单数 eye。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bright red dress caught everyone's eye at the party.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那件鲜红色的连衣裙在晚会上吸引了所有人的目光。
vocab_pack.from_passage: What catches our eyes and leaves us stunned is its ice sculptures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to be extremely surprised or shocked
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 leaves us stunned 为一般现在时第三人称单数（leaves），leave 后接宾语 us 和形容词补足语 stunned，表示“让我们目瞪口呆”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magician's trick left the audience stunned.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 魔术师的把戏让观众目瞪口呆。
vocab_pack.from_passage: leaves us stunned

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: more than frozen art, but a symbol
vocab_pack.definition_en: not only... but also... (used to emphasize that something is greater or more significant)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中连接两个名词短语 frozen art 和 a symbol，表示冰雕不仅仅是冰冻的艺术，更是人类智慧的象征。注意 but 前有逗号。
vocab_pack.example_en: This charity event is more than a fundraiser, but a call for unity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次慈善活动不仅仅是一场筹款，更是一种团结的号召。
vocab_pack.from_passage: more than frozen art, but a symbol of human wisdom

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that represents or stands for something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 a symbol of 作表语，与 be 动词连用，后接 human wisdom，表示“人类智慧的象征”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove is a symbol of peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子是和平的象征。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a symbol of human wisdom

vocab_pack.definition_en: to grow, develop, or be successful in a particular environment or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中位于情态动词 can 之后，使用动词原形，表示“即使在极寒中，美丽也能茁壮成长”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Some plants can thrive even in poor soil.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有些植物即使在贫瘠的土壤中也能茁壮成长。
vocab_pack.from_passage: beauty can thrive

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be occupied with an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 are busy harvesting 为系动词 are + 形容词 busy + 动名词 harvesting，描述工人正忙于采冰的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is busy preparing for the final exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她正忙于准备期末考试。
vocab_pack.from_passage: are busy harvesting thousands of cubic meters of ice

vocab_pack.definition_en: to gather a crop or natural resource
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 harvesting 为动名词形式，跟在 be busy 后面，表示“采集”冰块的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: Farmers harvest wheat in autumn.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 农民在秋天收割小麦。
vocab_pack.from_passage: harvesting thousands of cubic meters of ice

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cut something into pieces of a particular shape or size
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 slice 为动词原形（主语 they），后面紧跟宾语 the surface 和介词 into，表示“将冰面切成冰块”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The chef sliced the carrot into thin strips.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 厨师将胡萝卜切成细条。
vocab_pack.from_passage: They slice the surface into blocks of the same size

vocab_pack.definition_en: having identical dimensions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 of the same size 为介词短语作后置定语，修饰 blocks，表示“同样大小的冰块”。
vocab_pack.example_en: All the boxes are of the same size.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 所有盒子尺寸相同。
vocab_pack.from_passage: blocks of the same size

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a particular weight
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 weighing 为现在分词，在独立主格结构 each weighing 700 kg 中作谓语，表示“每个重达700公斤”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The suitcase weighs 20 kilograms.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个手提箱重20公斤。
vocab_pack.from_passage: each weighing 700 kg

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put things one on top of another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 are piled 为被动语态（一般现在时），表示冰砖“被堆叠”得像砖块一样。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children piled the blocks into a tower.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们把积木堆成一座塔。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ice blocks are piled like bricks

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something into the empty spaces between things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 fill the gaps 为动词短语，主语 they（工人），一般现在时，表示“填充框架和冰块之间的空隙”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He used cement to fill the gaps between the tiles.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他用水泥填补瓷砖之间的缝隙。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Then they fill the gaps between frames and blocks with ice and water

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become solid because of extreme cold
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 freeze 为动词原形（主语 which 指冰和水，复数），表示“水和冰立即冻结成坚如磐石的墙壁”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 水在0摄氏度结冰。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which freeze instantly to rock-solid walls

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely hard and strong; unbreakable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 rock-solid 为复合形容词，修饰 walls，表示“像岩石一样坚固的墙壁”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The foundation of the building is rock-solid.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 建筑物的地基坚如磐石。
vocab_pack.from_passage: rock-solid walls

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: apply water mixed with paper pulp onto a blown-up mould
vocab_pack.definition_en: to put or spread something onto a surface
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 apply 为动词原形（主语 they），宾语为 water mixed with paper pulp，onto 引出涂抹的对象，表示“将混有纸浆的水涂到充气模具上”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Apply the glue onto the paper evenly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 将胶水均匀地涂在纸上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: apply water mixed with paper pulp onto a blown-up mould

vocab_pack.definition_en: to combine one substance with another
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 mixed with 为过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 water，表示“与纸浆混合的水”。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should mix the flour with eggs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该把面粉和鸡蛋混合。
vocab_pack.from_passage: water mixed with paper pulp

vocab_pack.definition_en: inflated or expanded by blowing air into it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 blown-up 为过去分词转化为形容词，修饰 mould，表示“吹胀的模具”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We used a blown-up balloon for the experiment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们用一个充气气球做实验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: blown-up mould

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to compare intensity, indicating something is three times as strong as something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为比较结构，修饰 ice，表示“比普通冰强度高两倍（即三倍强度）”。注意倍数表达法。
vocab_pack.example_en: This new material is three times stronger than steel.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种新材料比钢强三倍。
vocab_pack.from_passage: creating ice three times stronger than normal

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take something away from the place it is
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 removed 为过去分词，与 is 构成被动语态（一般现在时），表示“模具被移走”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please remove your shoes before entering.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 进入前请脱鞋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the mould is removed

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something known or visible that was hidden
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 revealing 为现在分词，作结果状语，表示模具移除后“展现出”令人惊叹的创造物。
vocab_pack.example_en: The investigation revealed the truth.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 调查揭示了真相。
vocab_pack.from_passage: revealing an amazing, durable creation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to fix something firmly and deeply within something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 embedded in 为过去分词，与 are 构成被动语态，表示“LED灯被嵌入雕刻的凹槽中”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The diamond was embedded in the ring.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 钻石镶嵌在戒指上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: embedded in carved sinks

vocab_pack.definition_en: one layer at a time, in successive stages
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 layer by layer 作状语，修饰 are embedded，表示LED灯被“逐层”嵌入。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cake was decorated layer by layer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 蛋糕被一层一层地装饰。
vocab_pack.from_passage: layer by layer

vocab_pack.definition_en: to work in scheduled periods that replace each other, allowing continuous operation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 work 为动词原形（主语 teams，一般现在时），24/7 和 in shifts 均为状语，表示“全天候轮班工作”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hospital staff often work in shifts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医院工作人员经常轮班工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the teams work 24/7 in shifts

vocab_pack.definition_en: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; continuously
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 24/7 为固定表达，作状语修饰 work，表示“昼夜不停地”工作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The convenience store is open 24/7.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家便利店24小时营业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: work 24/7 in shifts

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: turning raw ice into breathtaking art
vocab_pack.definition_en: to change or transform something into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 turning 为现在分词，作结果状语，表示工人的奉献“将生冰变成了令人叹为观止的艺术”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magician turned the coin into a flower.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 魔术师把硬币变成了一朵花。
vocab_pack.from_passage: turning raw ice into breathtaking art

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to exist for all future time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 will last forever 为一般将来时，表示“体验和美丽将永远持续”。
vocab_pack.example_en: True love can last forever.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 真爱可以永恒。
vocab_pack.from_passage: will last forever

vocab_pack.definition_en: in spite of; without being affected by
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 Despite 为介词，后接名词短语 immense challenges，表示让步，“尽管有巨大挑战”。注意大写首字母是句首。
vocab_pack.example_en: He succeeded despite many failures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管多次失败，他成功了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Despite immense challenges

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely beautiful or impressive; awe-inspiring
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 breathtaking 为形容词，修饰 art，表示“令人惊叹的艺术”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The view from the top of the mountain was breathtaking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 山顶的景色令人叹为观止。
vocab_pack.from_passage: breathtaking art

vocab_pack.definition_en: very fine, subtle, or sensitive in texture, appearance, or nature
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 delicate 为形容词，修饰 beauty，表示“精致的美”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The delicate lacework required great skill.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 精致的花边需要高超的技艺。
vocab_pack.from_passage: delicate beauty

vocab_pack.definition_en: lasting for a very short time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 momentary 为形容词作表语，描述艺术本身“是短暂的”。
vocab_pack.example_en: There was a momentary pause in the conversation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 谈话中有片刻的停顿。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the art itself is momentary
